ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant high-intensity (white) central field comprising approximately 75-80% of the visible surface, bounded by low-intensity (black) peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region. Low-intensity pixels form thick, irregular bands along the trailing edges and terminal tips. Sparse, low-intensity punctate spots (mottling) are scattered across the medial white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular triangular peaks (serrations). The left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, more frequent micro-serrations with a smoother overall linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a concave upward curvature trailing from the submerged medial section toward the acute terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular, high-contrast, textured white/grey pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the terminal tip and trailing margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several thin, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible against the high-intensity background of the medial fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the right fluke tip, creating a distinct topographic protrusion and high-contrast texture anomaly.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the serration frequency and amplitude between the left and right lobe trailing edges.
